weightPotential.rationale: W1 applies: C1 sulfate chassis with prominent buffers, deposition = silicone (Dimethicone 6) + cationic guar (8) + late amodimethicone (23), no further converging family (glycol distearate, PEG-100 stearate, steareth-6 and carbomer are excluded) and no W-RICH -> moderate.

weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W1 conditions (a)-(c) all hold, no prominent payload lipid, protein or film former. Not low: an early silicone with a cationic guar is a deliberate deposition system.

dandruffSupport.rationale: No Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole; salicylic acid alone does not count.
